reason: My nights fill through PR people, my WhatsApp lists and regulars, not apps. A new app that isn't even public yet has no users I can point to, so paying €150 a month for badges and pushes to nobody makes no sense.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? A 3-month paid minimum on an app with no audience yet is a bet I'm not taking while I'm behind the bar every night.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real users in my area (thousands of downloads in Friuli/Veneto, or venues like mine reporting people who came through it), plus a free listing or a no-minimum trial so I can see it bring in people first.
